title: services: villages commands (settle, rates, build, complete_build, rename)
criteria:
Create realm/services/villages.py with ONLY these functions from BUILD.md 8.4 (do not write get_village_view / get_slot_view yet, a later task appends them): lock_village, levels, compute_rates, settle_village, settle_player_culture, after_change, build, complete_build, rename_village. Same names and signatures as the spec. Never commit, never call datetime.now().
Tests in tests/services/test_villages.py (DB fixtures `s`, `cfg`, `t0`; helper that calls realm.services.worlds.create_world(s, seed=1, speed=1, player_name='ผู้เล่น', tribe='stonehold', bot_count=0, cfg=cfg, real_now=t0) and loads the village/player). Hand-computed expectations for the fresh village (layout 4-4-4-6, speed 1): start stock 750 each; wood rate 8/h (4 woodcutters at level 0 x 2), stone 8, iron 8, food 12 - population 2 = 10/h; capacity 800 each (warehouse 0, granary 0).
- build woodcutter at slot 1 (now=t0): stock becomes wood 700, stone 660, iron 710, food 700; exactly 1 build_queue row (slot 1, type woodcutter, target_level 1, started_at t0, finishes_at t0+240s); exactly 1 pending BUILD_COMPLETE event with payload {'build_queue_id': id} and due_at == finishes_at; build_queue.event_id == that event's id.
- second build (slot 2) while town_hall < 10 -> GameError QUEUE_FULL; building the same busy slot again -> GameError (QUEUE_FULL comes first; that is fine).
- village with wood set to 0 -> INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES and nothing changes (no queue row, no event, stock same).
- barracks at slot 20 on the fresh village -> REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET; farm on slot 1 (a woodcutter slot) -> INVALID_SLOT; a field building already at max level -> MAX_LEVEL (set level directly in the DB); second warehouse in another center slot when one exists -> INVALID_SLOT.
- a different player's id calling build -> FORBIDDEN; unknown village id -> NOT_FOUND.
- complete_build at now=t0+240s: slot 1 becomes woodcutter level 1, build_queue row deleted; stock was settled BEFORE the level change: wood = 700 + 8*240/3600, food = 700 + 10*240/3600; res_updated_at == t0+240s; afterwards compute_rates gives wood 16/h (10 + 3*2) and food 9/h (12 - population 3); calling complete_build again for the deleted queue id is a no-op (no error).
- settle_village: stock grows by rate*elapsed and is capped at capacity; now earlier than res_updated_at changes nothing.
- compute_rates counts troop upkeep: a Troop row (home_village_id=village, location=village, unit spearman, count 10) lowers food rate by 10/h; a Movement row from this village with status 'moving' and units {'spearman': 5} lowers it by 5 more; a Movement with status 'done' does not.
- after_change: with food rate < 0 exactly one pending STARVATION_CHECK exists for the village, due at now + seconds_until_food_empty; calling after_change again does not duplicate it; when food rate >= 0 there is none.
- settle_player_culture adds culture_per_day * elapsed_days to player.culture_points and sets cp_updated_at = now.
- rename_village: trims the name, rejects empty or longer than 40 chars with INVALID_TARGET, other player -> FORBIDDEN.
notes:
DESIGN DECISIONS (follow exactly):
- lock_village: select(Village).where(id).with_for_update(); None -> GameError NOT_FOUND.
- levels(s, village_id): {type: highest level among that village's building rows}. BUT population must be computed from ALL building rows (sum pop_per_level*level per row, i.e. pass the list of (type, level) pairs of every row to economy.population), not from levels().
- compute_rates(s, village, now, cfg) -> (rates, capacity): load player and world (s.get); field_levels = [(type, level)] of rows whose cfg.buildings[type].kind == 'field'; gross = economy.gross_production(field_levels, world.speed, player.production_mult, cfg); pop = economy.population(all rows pairs); upkeep = sum(cfg.units[u].upkeep * count) over Troop rows with home_village_id == village.id (any location) + over every unit in the `units` JSONB dict of Movement rows with from_village_id == village.id and status == 'moving'; rates = economy.village_rates(gross, pop, upkeep, world.speed, cfg); capacity = economy.village_capacity(levels warehouse, levels granary, cfg) using levels().get('warehouse', 0) etc. `now` is unused but keep it in the signature.
- settle_village: new = economy.settle(Res(village.wood, ...), village.res_updated_at, now, rates, capacity); write back the four columns; set res_updated_at = now only if now > res_updated_at (otherwise leave everything untouched).
- settle_player_culture(s, player, now, cfg): if now <= cp_updated_at return. Gather (type, level) of all building rows of all villages of this player; world = s.get(World, player.world_id); player.culture_points += economy.culture_per_day(pairs, world.speed, cfg) * (now - cp_updated_at).total_seconds() / 86400; cp_updated_at = now.
- after_change(s, village, now, cfg): events.cancel_pending(s, village.world_id, EventType.STARVATION_CHECK, {'village_id': village.id}); rates, _ = compute_rates(...); secs = economy.seconds_until_food_empty(Res of the village stock, rates); if secs is not None: events.schedule(s, village.world_id, EventType.STARVATION_CHECK, now + timedelta(seconds=secs), {'village_id': village.id}).
- build step order (spec 8.4): lock -> if village.player_id != player_id: FORBIDDEN -> settle_village -> `slot_accepts(slot, btype, cfg, village.layout)` else INVALID_SLOT (also INVALID_SLOT if btype is not in cfg.buildings) -> center building (kind=='center') already exists in a DIFFERENT slot, either as a building row or as a build_queue row -> INVALID_SLOT -> current level of the slot (0 when no row), target = current + 1 -> target > construction.max_level(btype, village.is_capital, cfg) -> MAX_LEVEL -> construction.missing_requirements(btype, levels, cfg) non-empty -> REQUIREMENTS_NOT_MET (message = the Thai strings joined with ', ') -> len(build_queue rows of this village) >= construction.queue_limit(town_hall level, cfg) -> QUEUE_FULL -> a build_queue row already exists for this slot -> INVALID_SLOT -> cost = construction.building_cost(btype, target, cfg); if not stock.covers(cost) -> INSUFFICIENT_RESOURCES; subtract cost from the village columns -> time = construction.build_time_s(btype, target, town_hall level, world.speed, cfg) -> insert BuildQueue(started_at=now, finishes_at=now+timedelta(seconds=time), event_id=None), flush -> ev = events.schedule(BUILD_COMPLETE, finishes_at, {'build_queue_id': bq.id}); bq.event_id = ev.id -> after_change -> notify(s, village.world_id, [player_id], 'village', village.id) -> return bq. Town hall level = levels().get('town_hall', 0).
- complete_build(s, build_queue_id, now, cfg): bq = s.get(BuildQueue, id); if None return (idempotent). Lock the village, settle_village(now) BEFORE changing the level, upsert the Building row (village_id, slot) with type and level=bq.target_level, delete bq, flush, after_change, notify(... 'village' ...).
- rename_village(s, player_id, village_id, name, now, cfg): lock, owner check, name = name.strip(), 1..40 characters else GameError INVALID_TARGET, set village.name.
- Error messages are SHORT, SIMPLE Thai (e.g. 'ทรัพยากรไม่พอ', 'คิวก่อสร้างเต็ม', 'ไม่พบหมู่บ้าน', 'ไม่มีสิทธิ์สั่งหมู่บ้านนี้', 'ช่องนี้สร้างอาคารนี้ไม่ได้', 'อาคารถึงเลเวลสูงสุดแล้ว', 'ชื่อหมู่บ้านไม่ถูกต้อง'). Double-check every Thai string for typos.
- Use GameError and the code constants from realm.services.errors. Import events as `from realm.services import events`.
- Hand-calculate the test numbers in the test file as literals from the YAML values; do not compute expectations via the functions under test.
